title: Puran Poli with Warm Milk & Ghee
description: Sweet flatbread stuffed with spiced split-chana lentil and cardamom jaggery paste, drizzled with aromatic pure ghee.
emotional_resonance_reason: Quintessential Maharashtrian celebratory dish prepared during Holi and Ganesh Chaturthi family reunions.
flavor_profile: Sweet, aromatic cardamom and nutmeg, warm comforting ghee aroma

title: Kande Pohe (Maharashtrian Spiced Flattened Rice)
description: Fluffy flattened rice tossed with sauteed onions, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, and fresh coriander.
emotional_resonance_reason: Daily breakfast anchor in Pune households, evocative of morning radio and garden courtyard conversations.
flavor_profile: Savory, mild turmeric warmth, soft lemon-coriander finish

title: Varan Bhaat with Sajuk Tup (Ghee) and Lemon
description: Gentle slow-cooked toor dal seasoned with mild cumin and turmeric, served over steaming rice with pure cow's milk ghee and a wedge of lime.
emotional_resonance_reason: The ultimate soothing, maternal comfort food across Maharashtrian childhood memories.

title: Sunday Braised Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
description: Slow-braised tender chuck roast simmered with carrots, sweet yellow onions, celery, and fresh thyme in a rich beef reduction.
emotional_resonance_reason: Core family dinner ritual for mid-century Chicago homes following Sunday church and music broadcasts.
flavor_profile: Savory, rich umami broth, sweet tender root vegetables

title: Warm Cinnamon Stewed Apple Tart
description: Honeycrisp apples slowly baked with cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and a splash of vanilla inside a flaky golden crust.
emotional_resonance_reason: Aromas of baked cinnamon and apples are deeply potent sensory cues for emotional grounding and appetite stimulation.
flavor_profile: Warm spiced sweet apple, buttery aroma

title: Chicago Style Mild Tomato-Herb Pan Flatbread
description: Focaccia-style thick cornmeal pan bread topped with sweet crushed San Marzano plum tomatoes, fresh basil, and mild mozzarella.
emotional_resonance_reason: Reminiscent of iconic Chicago neighborhood pizzerias and high-school weekend outings.
flavor_profile: Tangy sweet tomato, mild creamy cheese, aromatic oregano
